Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Settlement Demand
January 26, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1339 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents James Castillo in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on February 24, 2023.
Our client was lawfully turning left at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of our client's
car. The collision was caused by your insured's failure to yield the right of way and to keep a proper lookout, and
liability is clear from the facts and the available physical evidence.
As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a whiplash injury to the neck and upper back. The symptoms have
included persistent pain, stiffness, reduced range of motion, and recurring headaches. Our client has received
ongoing medical treatment, including physical therapy and diagnostic imaging, and has missed time from work while
recovering. Treatment records and billing statements are enclosed.
Under the circumstances, we demand payment of $206,000.00 to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This
figure reflects medical expenses incurred to date, lost wages, and compensation for pain and suffering. This offer will
remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period,
we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Anthony Davis, neurologist
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
